rationale: saveWorkflowCheckpoint now recursively rewrites every string longer than 10,000 characters to a truncated value before persisting nodes and artifacts. Checkpoints are subsequently restored as workflow state, so a successful resume can receive altered outputs rather than the exact pre-failure state. The cast back to Record<string, WorkflowNodeResult> hides this semantic corruption, and the added tests cover cleanup behavior but not preservation or resumption of long values.
